2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch series introduces N_MEMORY_COMMON, a new concept for general-purpose memory separate from node memory (N_MEMORY). It creates a baseline to ensure private node memory is default opted-out of being touched by the MM, similar to ZONE_DEVICE. The series consists of three phases: introducing N_MEMORY_COMMON, defining memory not part of the general pool (N_MEMORY_PRIVATE), and adding feature bits for userland management.
